name: Fresh Reader
tagline: A simple Android client for your FreshRSS server
description:
Fresh Reader is a simple Android client for FreshRSS, the popular open source, self-hosted feed reader. If you run your own FreshRSS server, this app gives you a native way to read your subscriptions from your phone.

It's a small, experimental project, built by someone scratching their own itch for a proper FreshRSS app, straightforward and focused on just reading your feeds.
